tickets.title: Prepare liquidity planning analysis
tickets.text: Review expected cash needs, emergency reserve targets, recurring income sources, upcoming distributions, and potential funding sources for Mira Willowdoodle and Arlen Copperwisp. Summarize recommended cash cushion, any portfolio trades needed to raise cash, tax considerations, and questions for the lead advisor before client discussion. Address the shortfall in their six‑month cash reserve after accounting for the $24,000 wedding costs, the remaining apartment rent of $1,850 per month through May 31, and combined monthly spending of $9,600, and provide recommendations to meet the reserve target by 2024‑03‑18.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up by 2024-03-18 is to address the cash reserve and remaining lease impact.
